Issue Description: The item name does not follow the approved glossary term used elsewhere in the build.
Steps to Reproduce: Open Inventory > Consumables and highlight the first healing item.
Expected Result: The approved term Poção de Cura is used consistently.
Actual Result: The item is displayed as Poção de Saúde.

Issue Description: The string conflicts with the approved navigation term used in tutorials and map prompts.
Steps to Reproduce: Open the World Map and select an unlocked waypoint.
Expected Result: The action is labelled Viagem Rápida.
Actual Result: The action is labelled Transporte Rápido.

Issue Description: The noun does not agree with the singular numeral.
Steps to Reproduce: Collect a single coin from the tutorial chest.
Expected Result: Singular agreement is used with 1.
Actual Result: The plural form moedas is displayed.

Issue Description: The adjective does not agree with the feminine noun espada.
Steps to Reproduce: Equip the legendary sword from the Equipment screen.
Expected Result: Gender agreement is correct.
Actual Result: Lendário is displayed instead of lendária.

Issue Description: The translation uses the noun meaning professional résumé instead of the gameplay action.
Steps to Reproduce: Pause the game during any playable sequence.
Expected Result: The button resumes gameplay.
Actual Result: The button is labelled Currículo.

Issue Description: The string refers to the player's adventuring group, not a celebration.
Steps to Reproduce: Open the Social Menu and navigate to the Party tab.
Expected Result: The tab is labelled Grupo.
Actual Result: The tab is labelled Festa.

Issue Description: The localized label exceeds the fixed-width tab and overlaps the adjacent icon.
Steps to Reproduce: Open Settings at 1280 × 720 and select the final tab.
Expected Result: The label fits without clipping or overlap.
Actual Result: The string overlaps the tab icon.

Current PT-BR: Não há espaço suficiente disponível no inventário.
Issue Description: The toast exceeds two lines and is truncated before the final word.
Steps to Reproduce: Fill the inventory and attempt to collect another item at 1280 × 720.
Expected Result: The complete warning is visible within the toast.
Actual Result: The final portion of the message is clipped.

Issue Description: The protected variable name was translated, so the runtime value is not injected.
Steps to Reproduce: Complete the quest A Debt Repaid and view the reward notification.
Expected Result: The numerical reward replaces {amount}.
Actual Result: The literal text {quantidade} appears on screen.

Issue Description: The quantity variable was removed, preventing the objective from displaying the required target.
Steps to Reproduce: Start the arena challenge Trial by Ash.
Expected Result: The objective displays the required enemy count.
Actual Result: No quantity is shown.

Issue Description: The markup tags were translated and are no longer recognised by the UI parser.
Steps to Reproduce: Approach the first tutorial lever.
Expected Result: The interaction command is highlighted in yellow.
Actual Result: Raw markup is displayed in the tutorial text.

Issue Description: The closing bold tag is missing, causing the remaining article to stay bold.
Steps to Reproduce: Open Codex > Creatures > Ash Warden.
Expected Result: Only the label Fraqueza is bold.
Actual Result: The entire remaining entry is bold.

Issue Description: The notification heading does not follow the approved sentence-case pattern.
Steps to Reproduce: Accept the quest The Silent Bell.
Expected Result: The first word of the heading is capitalised.
Actual Result: The heading begins with a lowercase letter.

Issue Description: The label uses all caps while the interface style guide requires sentence case.
Steps to Reproduce: Open the Character Sheet.
Expected Result: The label follows sentence case.
Actual Result: The label is displayed in all caps.

Source (EN): Deal 25% more damage while below 30% health.
Current PT-BR: Cause 25% do dano enquanto estiver com menos de 30% de vida.
Issue Description: The localization changes a +25% damage bonus into dealing only 25% of normal damage.
Suggested PT-BR: Cause 25% a mais de dano enquanto estiver com menos de 30% dos Pontos de Vida.
Steps to Reproduce: Open Skills > Berserker > Final Stand.
Expected Result: The description communicates a 25% increase.
Actual Result: The description implies damage is reduced to 25%.

Current PT-BR: Reduz a recarga das habilidades para 2 segundos.
Issue Description: The translation changes a two-second reduction into setting every cooldown to two seconds.
Suggested PT-BR: Reduz em 2 segundos o tempo de recarga das habilidades.
Steps to Reproduce: Inspect the item Clockwork Sigil.
Expected Result: The tooltip describes a reduction of two seconds.
Actual Result: The tooltip states that cooldowns become two seconds.

Issue Description: The colon separating the label and value is missing.
Steps to Reproduce: Open the completed quest summary for The Silent Bell.
Expected Result: The label and value are separated by a colon.
Actual Result: The punctuation is missing.

Issue Description: An incorrect space appears before the question mark.
Steps to Reproduce: Select Quit to Title from the pause menu.
Expected Result: Brazilian Portuguese punctuation spacing is used.
Actual Result: A space appears before the question mark.

Current PT-BR: Ponto de Salvamento / Ponto de Save
Issue Description: Two different translations are used for the same gameplay object.
Steps to Reproduce: Compare the first tutorial prompt with the World Map legend.
Expected Result: The same approved term is used in both locations.
Actual Result: Two variants are displayed.

Issue Description: The class name changes between character creation and codex entries.
Steps to Reproduce: Compare Character Creation > Classes with Codex > Classes.
Expected Result: The approved class name Patrulheiro is used consistently.
Actual Result: The codex uses Arqueiro.
